g.text: Human Elafin in explicit water: independent short MD pilots

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64737a

g.text: 2REL conformer 1 | AMBER ff14SB / TIP3P-FB | 300 K, 1 bar, 0.15 M NaCl | 3 completed replicas

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64737a

g.text: Each replica: 100 ps equilibration + 1 ns unrestrained production. Shaded early production is excluded from RMSF and summary means.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64737a

g.text: RMSD uses the minimized initial structure. RMSF uses each replica’s 0.2–1.0 ns mean after WAP alignment; these are temporal MD fluctuations.
